title: Fix decode_uuencode fragile heuristic with explicit was_limit_hit field
description: decode.rs lines 192-198: distinguishes max_bytes hit from genuine truncation by checking block.data.len() >= limit. This is fragile. Add was_limit_hit: bool to uuencoding::DecodedBlock and set it in decode_limited when the limit fires. mime-tree can then read that field directly instead of guessing.
close_reason: Added was_limit_hit: bool to DecodedBlock. decode.rs sets it when max_bytes fires. mime-tree decode_uuencode now reads was_limit_hit directly instead of the data.len()>=limit heuristic. 4 new tests.
